lessonTitle: 27. Roots of a polynomial in one variable
lessonTitleEnglish: Roots of a polynomial in one variable
unit: Algebra · Chapter 4. Polynomials in one variable
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: a is a root of P(x) if P(a) = 0; by Bézout, that happens exactly when x − a divides P(x).
stages.headlineEnglish: a is a root of P(x) if P(a) = 0; by Bézout, that happens exactly when x − a divides P(x).

stages.headline: For integer coefficients and leading coefficient 1, integer roots divide the constant term: test ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6 for x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6.
stages.headlineEnglish: For integer coefficients and leading coefficient 1, integer roots divide the constant term: test ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6 for x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6.

stages.headline: A polynomial of degree n has at most n roots.
